name: com.immersivex.media
description: Plays immersive media in the user's room with one component and the same acrylic controls: GenXR 3.5D hologram streams and 4D splat sequences, Gaussian splats (.ply, .splat, .spz, .ksplat), point clouds, animated glTF/GLB models (including Draco and KTX2 compression), OBJ/PLY/STL meshes and mesh sequences, 2D, 180° and 360° video, and flat, 180° and 360° photos.
